design_description: A black and gold jersey with an energetic brush-stroke aesthetic. The clean black base is interrupted by sharp diagonal gold streaks, concentrated around one shoulder and the opposite lower side to create an asymmetrical, fast-moving composition. Gold trim on the collar and sleeve cuffs ties the graphics together, while the front typography is also finished in gold for a consistent two-colour identity. The back keeps the graphics restrained around the shoulder and lower hem, leaving plenty of clean black space for a large white name and number with dark outlining. Overall, Team Bergen has a bold, modern and aggressive look, using the gold streaks as the main visual signature.
